verdict.rationale: BILL provides an official MCP server, but per docs-18 it is scoped only to letting AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) query BILL's API documentation — not to actually invoke BILL's AP/AR/S&E operations as an agent. This is a legitimate official MCP server, but it's a docs-assistant, not a full agentic action interface. Missing for 10: an MCP server (or evidence of one) that exposes actual BILL operations/tools for agents to execute, independent confirmation of real-world usage.
